_comment: LOD phase 5 acceptance-test demo (#560): shows the multi-resolution design's payoff visually -- the camera opens tight on the ~1,720-soldier engaged close-tier front (same layout as benchmarks/scenarios/cannae-scale.json), holds, then pulls back in one smooth move to reveal the far-tier reserve corps stacked behind the line -- tens of thousands more soldiers, each an aggregate FarTierFormation record rather than individually-simulated bodies -- then holds on the wide view. No input steps: this is a pure camera-presentation demo (a 'scenario' stages both armies directly, so drill mode is neither needed nor applicable -- see Battle._ready, which spawns strictly from 'scenario' when present and ignores drill_mode's default-line-spawn branch), matching camera-showcase.json's pattern. The default forest, but no hill: the benchmark layout this clip mirrors stages the right-hand cavalry and archers where the default hill stands, and the clip is about tier scale, not terrain, so the hill is left off rather than the layout moved.
